rationales.description: Accruals exceptions totaling $711,808.57 exceed the $50,000 materiality threshold, posing a significant risk to financial accuracy and compliance.
rationales.recommended_action: Review and resolve accruals exceptions by validating underlying transactions and adjusting entries as necessary.

rationales.description: AR exceptions totaling $2,586,167.48 indicate potential inaccuracies in receivables data, which could materially impact reported financials.
rationales.recommended_action: Investigate AR discrepancies, reconcile outstanding balances, and ensure accurate reporting of receivables.

rationales.description: Bank duplicates detected (13 instances) suggest control failures in payment processing, increasing the risk of misstatements and fraud.
rationales.recommended_action: Perform a detailed review of bank transactions to identify and eliminate duplicate entries, and strengthen controls to prevent recurrence.

rationales.description: Flux exceptions totaling 47 instances indicate non-compliance with regulatory requirements for variance analysis, which could trigger audit findings.
rationales.recommended_action: Conduct a thorough variance analysis to address flux exceptions and document corrective actions for audit purposes.
